description: Small CPU-only numeric illustration of 2x2 Hessian block preconditioning and global null-space risk; not a GPU benchmark.
limitations: One seed; 1200 by 96 synthetic cases, float64 CPU arithmetic and scipy L-BFGS-B; GPU throughput and MLX solver behavior are not measured.
The candidate uses transformed-coordinate stopping and the original gradient is independently scored.
Source and result hashes were captured after the experiment, not during it.
The row-sample correlation pairing and exact covariance blocks are a toy demonstration, not a validated production strategy.
